title: Signal: Unsafe deserialization via unserialize (php) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the unserialize call in php code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any unserialize call matches, including decoding of trusted local state. Trust in the byte source needs human review.
fpNotes: Loading trusted session checkpoints or local caches is the common false positive; confirm the bytes cannot arrive from the network.
